name: Kururugi Shiki
source:
Looks-like-an-extrovert asocial type.
Reason for wanting to die: Got tired of living.
Lingering attachment to this world: Wants to have a real girlfriend.

A high-school senior and former captain of the basketball team. A friendly, sociable, and cheerful playboy with an uninhibited personality that might seem unfit for reaching his goal of ‘getting a true girlfriend’. He lives alone with his foster father.

He tends to be goofy and amiable while joking around, but in reality he’s a very sceptical person. Incredibly sharp and observant with a deep sense of morality and human sensitivity. A man made up of contradictions as he’s also rational and cold-hearted, which makes him go from being open and considerate to ice-cold in an instant.

He’s brimming with curiosity and repeatedly gets invested in a wide range of things, but loses interest in them very fast. Those around him look at him with either admiration or disgust. 70% of the time it’s the former. He often contradicts himself during conversations as his opinions change quite frequently. Girls and boys of all ages tend to ask him for advice a lot, so he probably knows a considerable amount of other people’s secrets.

[Adapted from [url=http://clubsuicide.net]the official website[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/_MORPATH?s=20&t=j3Xffhv5h-Yo19sJry3tvA]Twitter[/url].]
